fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the rear of the building with visible address or unit identifiers to help responders orient when front access is not used.
• Post signage at each access point identifying which portion of the building or parking area it serves.
• Keep drive aisles clear of parked vehicles and obstructions to allow emergency vehicles to move through the property without stopping.
• Trim vegetation in landscaped areas where it extends into or near drive aisles to maintain clear sightlines for approaching responders.
• Mark the primary entrance area with reflective address signage visible from the street.
• Identify the limited rear access point with posted signage so responders can locate it quickly without circling the building.
• Keep the perimeter fencing gates accessible and clearly marked so responders can identify entry points without delay.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Building; Vegetation Near Building; Landscaped Island; Scattered Shrubs; Open Paved Area; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; Scattered Trees
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs and low branches where vegetation is growing directly against or touching building walls.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from landscaped areas located close to buildings.
• Keep the landscaped island vegetation trimmed low and free of dead material to reduce concentration of burnable plants near the paved area.
• Thin shrubs scattered across the property where they are grouped closely together near structures.
• Maintain the open paved areas free of encroaching vegetation along their edges.
